steps.step: re-apply after rollback matches first apply

deviations: Data risk, no question raised: anomaly_nk is nvarchar(240). For event types it is '<type>:<event_nk>'. The longest prefix, 'INVOICE_MATCHES_MULTIPLE_EVENTS:', is 32 characters, and event_nk can be up to 220, so an event_nk longer than 208 characters would not fit. The load then fails with error 2628, logs Failed and changes nothing; the key is never shortened. Phase 1 event_nk values are short ('RN:<contact_no>:<year>'), so this is not expected in real data. A unit test covers this failure.
notes:
MOD-011 delivers Layercake.usp_load_silv_data_anomaly_invoice (MIG-0015). It reconciles six anomaly types for amount Campaign Years from 2022, in the same way as the MOD-008 segment anomaly load: new cases are inserted, cases no longer raised are deleted, a still-raised case whose detail changed gets the new detail in place (first_detected_at and last_seen_at are kept), and everything else is left alone. Rows of other anomaly types are never touched.

How each type is found:
- EVENT_NO_INVOICE: silv_event_amount.match_outcome is 'No eligible invoice'.
- INVOICE_MATCHES_MULTIPLE_EVENTS: match_outcome is 'Invoice shortfall'.
- INVOICE_NO_EVENT and EVENT_MATCHES_MULTIPLE_INVOICES: an invoice in vw_silv_eligible_invoice that no event's invoice_rec_id points to. It is a surplus (EVENT_MATCHES_MULTIPLE_INVOICES) when the contact has any event with that amount Campaign Year, and INVOICE_NO_EVENT otherwise.
- READMISSION_FREE and READMISSION_NO_FEE: a matched Readmission whose invoice has no live own line typed 'readmission fee'. Own lines share the invoice's account and voucher. Line types come through silv_ref_invoice_line_type, with a NULL ricinvoicetype matched as N''. READMISSION_FREE when the event date is between DATEADD(month, 3, campaign_year_start) and the day before DATEADD(month, 6, campaign_year_start) for the event's amount Campaign Year.

anomaly_nk is '<type>:<event_nk>' for event types and '<type>:<rec_id>' for invoice types. The event amount is never read.

Choices I made that the design doesn't fix:
- A Readmission whose Campaign Year has no config row has no free window, so it gets READMISSION_NO_FEE.
- A matched invoice that is no longer live has no own lines, so its Readmission counts as having no fee line.

The developer unit tests (5) cover:
- a year with no config row;
- a NULL ricinvoicetype fee line;
- an in-place detail update logged as 0 inserted, 1 updated, 0 deleted;
- the 1/1/1 counts, the exact anomaly_nk and the detail text;
- the data-driven error path (error 2628, logged Failed, target unchanged).

No grants are needed. Starting point: 0 of 29 Tester tests passed (the procedure didn't exist yet). Final run: 29 of 29 Tester tests and 5 unit tests pass. Round-trip and checks pass; the sqlfluff findings are advisory.

Test-first: the first run had 0 of 29 of the Tester's tests passing; the final run passed 29 of 29 and 5 unit test(s), in 3 run(s).
